# Greeks IPTV — Greek IPTV (goldengateiptv.gr)

> Greeks IPTV sells Greek IPTV subscriptions: live TV channels, sports, movies and series with Greek subtitles, streamed over the internet in SD, HD, FHD and 4K to Smart TVs, Amazon Fire TV Stick, Android, iPhone/iPad/Apple TV, MAG boxes, Enigma2 receivers, Windows and Mac. Plans run from 1 day to 2 years for 1–3 devices, with a trial before purchase, one-time payment (no automatic renewal) and 24/7 support. Website language: Greek.

## Key facts
- Service: Greek IPTV subscription (internet TV, no satellite or cable needed)
- Price for 1 device: 1 day €3 · 1 month €15 · 3 months €32 · 6 months €42 · 1 year €62 · 2 years €110
- Price for 2 devices: 1 day €6 · 1 month €24 · 3 months €47 · 6 months €67 · 1 year €94 · 2 years €199
- Price for 3 devices: 1 day €9 · 1 month €35 · 3 months €80 · 6 months €99 · 1 year €150 · 2 years €297
- Trial: available before purchase, requested via WhatsApp
- Activation: login details (username, password, URL) sent by email 5 minutes to 6 hours after payment is verified
- Payment: PayPal, and Visa/Mastercard through PayPal; no automatic renewal
- Refund: within 7 days if a technical problem on our side is not fixed within 48 hours, if login details are not delivered within 24 hours, or for a duplicate payment
- Internet speed: at least 15 Mbps for HD, 25 Mbps recommended for 4K
- Support: 24/7 via WhatsApp (+212 707 711 512) and email (greeksiptv@gmail.com), in Greek and English
- Last updated: 2026-10-15
